akis_islands.title: Aki's Islands - Continent Layout
akis_islands.randomize.tip: Try another coastline while keeping the selected layout and size. Does not change Minecraft's world seed.
akis_islands.radius.tip: Layout scale: 1,000-100,000 blocks. Irregular coastlines can extend farther.
akis_islands.count.tip: 2-6 main landmasses. Mixed continents also adds randomized satellite islands. Ignored for one continent.
akis_islands.terrain: Terrain follows Minecraft and your mods.
akis_islands.climate.title: Latitude Climate
akis_islands.climate.mode.tip: Optional cold north, broad temperate middle, and hot south. Keeps native humidity, biome placement rules, and underground climates.
akis_islands.climate.preset.tip: Click to cycle: Default (65% middle), Balanced (50%), Temperate (80%), Gentle (65%, weaker bands), Wide extremes (25%, stronger bands and shorter transitions). Keeps climate on/off unchanged. Percentages describe planned latitude spans, not exact biome area.
akis_islands.climate.reset.tip: Restore 65% normal middle, 85% band strength, and 100% transition length with smooth easing. Keeps climate on/off unchanged. Choose Done to keep the values, or Cancel to discard them.
akis_islands.climate.middle.tip: 10-90% of the planned north-south span. Lower values shrink the temperate center and give the cold north and hot south more room. Default 65% keeps a broad middle.
akis_islands.climate.strength.tip: 0-100%. Higher values make latitude more influential. Local climate variation is retained; zero leaves temperature unchanged.
akis_islands.climate.transition.tip: 50-200%. Lower values reach strong cold/hot temperatures sooner; higher values spread the change over more distance beyond the normal middle. Changes remain smooth.
akis_islands.climate.external.tip: Natural Temperature is installed and controls biome climate. Use its settings, or remove it to use Aki's optional latitude system. Its config is never modified.
akis_islands.preview.tip: Shape preview. Your mods generate the terrain.
akis_islands.unsupported: This world type uses an unsupported custom generator.
